title: DEGRADE
summary:
Source images pushed through noise until the subject survives only as structure.

The series began as a test: how far can a familiar image be degraded before it stops being that image? Each piece runs the same source through increasing displacement, and the answer turned out to be much further than expected — recognition survives long after detail does not.

Working at forty pieces forced a discipline that a handful never would. The middle of the series is where it gets interesting: coherent enough to read, damaged enough to doubt.

Printed at scale the noise reads as tooth rather than error, which was not planned and is now the point.
